examples.text: mān'ārāmā, bhikkhave, pajā mānaratā mānasammuditā. sā tathāgatena mānavinaye dhamme desiyamāne sussūsati sotaṃ odahati aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti.

yā uṇṇatī s'āssa vighātabhūmi, mān'ātimānaṃ vadate pan'eso, etam'pi disvā na vivādayetha, na hi tena suddhiṃ kusalā vadanti.

khattiyo seṭṭho janetasmiṃ, ye gottapaṭisārino, vijjācaraṇasampanno, so seṭṭho devamānuse'ti.

tatra ce, bhikkhave, pare tathāgataṃ sakkaronti garuṃ karonti mānenti pūjenti, tatra, bhikkhave, tathāgatassa na hoti ānando na somanassaṃ na cetaso uppilāvitattaṃ.

52349.commentary: (ANa) māmakā'ti te mayhaṃ bhikkhū mama santakā na honti. te mayhan'ti idaṃ pana satthāraṃ uddissa pabbajitattā vuttaṃ.

māyāvissa purisapuggalassa amāyā hoti parinibbānāya. thaddhassa purisapuggalassa atthaddhiyaṃ hoti parinibbānāya.

kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na samaṇasāmīcippaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti? yassa kassaci, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno… māyāvissa māyā appahīnā hoti, pāp'icchassa pāpikā icchā appahīnā hoti, micchādiṭṭhikassa micchādiṭṭhi appahīnā hoti
sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, māyāvī samaṇo gotamo āvaṭṭaniṃ māyaṃ jānāti yāya aññatitthiyānaṃ sāvake āvaṭṭetī'ti.

52371.meaning1: like an illusion; similar to a magic trick

examples.text: pheṇapiṇḍ'ūpamaṃ rūpaṃ, vedanā bubbuḷ'ūpamā, marīcik'ūpamā saññā, saṅkhārā kadal'ūpamā, māy'ūpamañ'ca viññāṇaṃ, desit'ādiccabandhunā.

52372.meaning1: governed by mā; syntactically related to mā

examples.text: 420, 471. māyoge sabbakāle ca.
hiyyattanīajjatanī'icc'etā vibhattiyo yadā māyogā, tadā sabbakāle ca honti. mā gamā, mā vacā, mā gamī, mā vacī.

52373.notes: five māra 1. kilesamāra, 2. khandhamāra, 3. abhisaṅkhāramāra, 4. devaputtamāra, 5. maccumāra

examples.text: etadaññāya ye satā, diṭṭhadhamm'ābhinibbutā, na te māravas'ānugo, na te mārassa paddhagū'ti.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, tumhe'pi māro pāpimā satataṃ samitaṃ paccupaṭṭhito, app'eva nām'āhaṃ imesaṃ cakkhuto vā otāraṃ labheyyaṃ
yato tumhe, bhikkhave, indriyesu guttadvārā viharissatha, atha tumhehi'pi māro pāpimā nibbijja pakkamissati, otāraṃ alabhamāno, kummamhā'va siṅgālo'ti.
ayaṃ vuccati ariyasāvako akaraṇīyo mārassa akaraṇīyo pāpimato'ti

52375.commentary: (THIa) janamārakamajjhagatā'ti janamārako vuccati mūḷhagabbho. mātugāmajanassa mārako, majjhagatā janamārakā kucchigatā, mūḷhagabbhā'ti attho.

examples.text: galake api kantanti, sukhumāliniyo visāni khādanti, janamārakamajjhagatā, ubho'pi byasanāni anubhonti.

52376.meaning2: belonging to the group of Mara deities

52377.meaning1: Māra's eye; Māra's vision; death's sight
52377.commentary: (MNa) apadaṃ vadhitvā māracakkhun'ti ten'eva pariyāyena yathā mārassa cakkhu apadaṃ hoti nippadaṃ, appatiṭṭhaṃ, nirārammaṇaṃ, evaṃ vadhitvā'ti attho.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu andham'akāsi māraṃ, apadaṃ vadhitvā māracakkhuṃ adassanaṃ gato pāpimato.

52378.meaning1: who has left Death behind; (comm) who has abandoned the defilements

examples.text: tamonudaṃ pāragataṃ mah'esiṃ, taṃ pattipattaṃ vasimaṃ anāsavaṃ, visan'taraṃ taṇhakkhaye vimuttaṃ, taṃ ve muniṃ antimadehadhāriṃ, mārañ'jahaṃ brūmi jarāya pāraguṃ.

52379.commentary: (DNa) maraṇavadhabhay'attano'ti ettha maraṇasaṅkhāto vadho maraṇavadho, maraṇavadhato bhayaṃ maraṇavadhabhayaṃ, taṃ attano jānitvā.

examples.text: māraṇavadhabhay'attano viditvā, paṭivirato paraṃ māraṇāy'ahosi, tena sucaritena saggam'agamā, sukataphalavipākam'anubhosi.

52380.meaning1: close to death; deadly; nearly fatal

examples.text: atha kho bhagavato vass'ūpagatassa kharo ābādho uppajji, bāḷhā vedanā vattanti māraṇ'antikā.

52381.meaning1: beating to death; punishing to death
52381.commentary: (DNt) vadha-saddo attānaṃ vadhitvā vadhitvā rodatī'ti-ādīsu (pāci. 879) bādhan'attho'pi hotī'ti tato visesan'atthaṃ māraṇavadhenā'ti vuttaṃ, māraṇasaṅkhātena vadhenā'ti attho. bādhan'attho eva vā vadha-saddo, māraṇena, bādhanena cā'ti attho.

examples.text: māraṇavadhabhay'attano viditvā, paṭivirato paraṃ māraṇāy'ahosi, tena sucaritena saggam'agamā, sukataphalavipākam'anubhosi.

52382.commentary: (DNa) maraṇavadhabhay'attano'ti ettha maraṇasaṅkhāto vadho maraṇavadho, maraṇavadhato bhayaṃ maraṇavadhabhayaṃ, taṃ attano jānitvā.

examples.text: māraṇavadhabhay'attano viditvā, paṭivirato paraṃ māraṇāy'ahosi, tena sucaritena saggam'agamā, sukataphalavipākam'anubhosi.
bhūnahaccāni kammāni, attamāraṇiyāni ca, karontā n'āvabujjhanti, kodhajāto parābhavo.
aṭṭhānam'etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ itthī mārattaṃ kareyya

52386.meaning1: subject to death; of the nature to die

examples.text: atha kho taṇhā ca arati ca ragā ca māradhītaro yena māro pāpimā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā māraṃ pāpimantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsiṃsu.

52390.meaning1: Māra's realm; death's domain; power of death

examples.text: vārijo'va thale khitto, okam'okata'ubbhato, pariphandat'idaṃ cittaṃ, māradheyyaṃ pahātave.
yā ca diṭṭhadhammikā kāmasaññā, yā ca samparāyikā kāmasaññā, ubhayam'etaṃ māradheyyaṃ, mārass'esa visayo, mārass'esa nivāpo, mārass'esa gocaro

52391.meaning1: which follow (one) to the end in Māra's realm

52393.meaning1: reached Māra's realm; entered death's domain

examples.text: bhavarāgaparetebhi, bhavarāg'ānusārībhi, māradheyy'ānupannehi, n'āyaṃ dhammo susambudho.

52394.meaning1: overcome Māra's realm; conquered death's domain; vanquished the power of death

examples.text: sammappadhānā māradheyy'ābhibhūtā, te asitā jātimaraṇabhayassa pāragū, te tusitā jetvā māraṃ savāhiniṃ te anejā, sabbaṃ namucibalaṃ upātivattā te sukhitā'ti.

52395.meaning1: who drives out Māra; who dispels death

examples.text: atthi sakyakule jāto, buddho appaṭipuggalo, sabb'ābhibhū māranudo, sabbattha'm'aparājito.

52396.commentary: (SNa) mārapaññattī'ti māro'ti paññatti nāmaṃ nāmadheyyaṃ. atthi tattha māro vā mārapaññatti vā'ti tattha maraṇaṃ vā maraṇan'ti idaṃ nāmaṃ vā atthī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā samiddhi yena bhagavā … bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, māro, māro'ti, bhante, vuccati. kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, māro vā assa mārapaññatti vā'ti?

aṭṭha kho imā, sāriputta, parisā. katamā aṭṭha? khattiyaparisā, brāhmaṇaparisā, gahapatiparisā, samaṇaparisā, cātumahārājikaparisā, tāvatiṃsaparisā, māraparisā, brahmaparisā, imā kho, sāriputta, aṭṭha parisā.
nevāpiko'ti kho, bhikkhave, mārass'etaṃ pāpimato adhivacanaṃ. nevāpikaparisā'ti kho, bhikkhave, māraparisāy'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. migajātā'ti kho, bhikkhave, samaṇabrāhmaṇānam'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
kusalī bhāsasī tesaṃ, mārapāsappahāyinaṃ, kassa te dhammam'aññāya, acchiduṃ bhavabandhanan'ti.
bhikkhu baddho cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu, āvāsagato mārassa, mārassa vasaṃ gato, paṭimukkassa mārapāso.
